title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
content:
The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

Image Credits: Trajectory AI Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts Marina Temkin 3:13 PM PST · November 2, 2026 Whether developed by OpenAI or Anthropic or built on open source alternatives, current AI models share a critical limitation: They don’t learn from their mistakes without further training.
Businesses adapting these models for specialized fields, such as law and finance, typically get around this by fine-tuning general models. However, that often requires hiring internal research teams or relying on expensive consultants, commonly known as forward-deployed engineers (FDEs).
Trajectory , a startup founded about a year ago by three Stanford classmates with experience at Google DeepMind and Apple, wants to automate that process, allowing AI models to learn from feedback and continuously improve at specialized tasks.
The 18-person company just announced that it raised $45 million in a Series A round at a $300 million valuation, led by Sequoia, with participation from Nvidia, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.
Trajectory co-founder Ronak Malde compared foundational models to a very smart PhD student who’s always starting a new job. “But what the economy values is someone who worked on the job for 30 years,” he told TechCrunch.

title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
content:
RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

Image Credits: TechCrunch/AI generated AI Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI Julie Bort 2:14 PM PST · November 2, 2026 While much attention has focused on the updated financials Anthropic revealed in its revised S-1/A on Monday (revenue is soaring, but so are expenses), the AI lab dropped another little bombshell in the fine print.
The filing seems to warn that the company is on the cusp of creating a model capable of recursive self-improvement (RSI).
RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return, in which AI builds itself into something powerful enough that it slips beyond human control and may be indifferent to the damage it causes while achieving its goals.
To AI enthusiasts, RSI, or some version of AI reliably using itself to improve, represents the technology’s promise, where it becomes a tool of unimaginable productivity, scientific discovery, and more.
Anthropic seems to believe that RSI is both a promise and a peril. It says in the S-1 that it uses AI in its R&D, but it cautions: “Using AI to help build more capable AI could also pose a considerable safety risk, particularly if it sharply accelerates the pace of progress. title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
content:
The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

Separately on Monday, the Daily News, the Chicago Tribune, and the Orlando Sentinel filed a similar lawsuit. Both were brought in federal court in Manhattan.
“In this way, Brave acts both like a burglar that misappropriates the content of publishers, and an AI ‘fence’ that sells stolen content to third parties,” the suit reads. It says Brave built an index of more than 30 billion web pages using an unidentified crawler, leaving publishers unable to block it.
The suit also targets a Brave browser feature that bypasses paywalls and the company’s practice of blocking publishers’ ads while selling its own.
Founded in 2015, Brave has raised roughly $250 million to date, according to private-market trackers. The Times seeks an injunction and damages.
Brave did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
content:
Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

Image Credits: 42AI AI 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’ Ram Iyer 8:30 AM PST · November 2, 2026 Here’s a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?
Israeli startup 42AI says it is developing a “behavioral world model” that can do just that, and it has just come out of stealth with $62.5 million in seed funding. The company is initially running its predictive system at a handful of financial brokerages, where it says the model can help predict how individual traders will respond to volatile conditions.
“Behavior is not deterministic; it’s constantly probabilistic,” 42AI’s CEO and co-founder Amit Gal-Or told TechCrunch when I asked him to justify his company’s tall claim. He argues that people have underlying psychological tendencies that influence their decisions even when their circumstances change, and that’s what the startup is trying to measure and convert into data that the model can understand.
“A week from now, you might be a different person, but your tendencies will always play out in certain areas to a probability or distribution,” his co-founder and CTO Ehud Ezra added. And that, the company argues, is what the model does: show the probability of a person making a certain decision.

title: 传苹果逐步淘汰非触控 MacBook Pro；谷歌 AI 被指正切断互联网流量；赛力斯：问界全面进入欧洲市场
content:
「幽灵学生」借助 AI 骗取助学金，美国调查揭露跨国教育欺诈网络

【苹果 CEO：不会为了做 AI 而做产品】
苹果 CEO 约翰·特努斯近日接受采访时，为苹果当前在人工智能领域的布局进行辩护。过去几年，外界常认为苹果在 AI 赛道落后，尤其是苹果推迟推出更强版本的 Siri，该功能直到今年夏天才正式上线。
特努斯是苹果资深高管，9 月初正式出任 CEO。他承认「每个人都有自己的看法」，但坚称：「我对我们现在所处的阶段很满意。」
特努斯补充，苹果一定会在新产品中运用人工智能，但他表示：「我们不想为了做 AI 而推出 AI。如果我们做得好，用户不会去思考这个功能到底是 AI 实现的，还是传统软件实现的。重点在于，我们是否打造出用户真正喜爱的产品。」（来源：环球市场播报）

【OpenAI、谷歌、微软和 Anthropic 联手推行 AI 数据抓取退出标准】
11 月 1 日消息，OpenAI、谷歌、微软以及 Anthropic 近日宣布将采用一项新标准，内容发布方可以借助该标准选择拒绝 AI 抓取自家网站内容。借助这项管控机制，内容发布方可以一次性向多家 AI 企业统一申明自身针对 AI 模型训练的内容使用偏好，而不必为每家企业单独设置规则。
该标准由 Anthropic 技术负责人 Kevin Kelley 向互联网工程任务组（IETF）提出，并将集成在网站的 robots.txt 文件中。
长期以来，robots.txt 文件用于告知网络爬虫哪些网站内容允许抓取、哪些禁止抓取，适用场景包含搜索索引、网页归档以及 AI 模型训练。目前，网站必须向每一家 AI 企业分别单独声明自己的 AI 训练相关内容使用偏好。在此背景下，各类 AI 爬虫持续抓取网站内容、将网页素材输入 AI 模型训练，内容发布方正为此焦头烂额。（来源：新浪财经）

【苹果计划在 2027 年逐步淘汰高端非触控 MacBook Pro】
苹果刚刚为 MacBook Pro 引入触控屏幕，但这一变化可能只是产品线调整的开始。根据彭博社记者马克·古尔曼（Mark Gurman）在其 Power On 通讯中的消息，苹果计划在 2027 年推出第二代触控屏 MacBook Pro 时，逐步取消现有的高端非触控版本，届时除了入门级 14 英寸机型之外，MacBook Pro 产品线可能将全面转向触控屏设计。
苹果在 2026 年 10 月底推出了首批配备触控屏的 MacBook Pro，提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸两种尺寸，采用名为 PROLED XDR 的新型显示屏，并搭载 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max 处理器。这是苹果首次在 MacBook Pro 上正式引入触控操作，意味着公司坚持多年的笔记本电脑不需要触摸屏这一产品理念出现了明显转变。
当然，目前关于 2027 年产品线调整的消息仍然属于爆料，并非苹果正式公布的产品规划。（来源：cnbeta）

【Google AI Mode 正在切断互联网流量】
Google 正在改变人们使用互联网的方式，而这种变化可能给整个网络生态系统带来深远影响。随着人工智能搜索逐渐取代传统搜索结果页面，用户越来越习惯直接从 AI 生成的摘要和对话中获取答案，而不是点击链接访问具体网站。
对于长期依赖 Google 搜索流量获取用户的企业和网络出版商而言，这意味着一个曾经稳定的流量来源正在迅速萎缩。
美国社交平台 Reddit 最近公布的第三季度财报，成为这一趋势的一个典型案例。公司联合创始人兼首席执行官史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）在财报电话会议上直言，用户仍然需要 Reddit 上的内容，但 Google 已经不像过去那样将用户引导至 Reddit。
霍夫曼表示，Google 仍在大量抓取 Reddit 上的内容，说明用户对这些信息的需求并没有消失。真正发生变化的是 Google 的 AI 搜索模式：它能够直接回答用户的问题，却不再像传统搜索那样为内容提供者带来相应的网站访问量。（来源：网易）

【OpenAI 考虑将数据中心重新包装为「AI 算力园区」】
11 月 2 日消息，据外媒 Axios 昨天报道，OpenAI 正准备在周二美国中期选举结束后，发起大规模公关宣传活动。
OpenAI 首席全球事务官克里斯 · 莱汉（Chris Lehane）对此表示，此次中期选举将成为 2028 年总统大选的「预告片」。未来，人工智能将成为大选的核心议题。
莱汉提到，他们计划制定 AI 发展速度限制；并寻找方法，让人们认识到 AI 如何赋能日常生活；推动美国参与制定全球标准；以及将数据中心重新包装为「AI 算力园区」。
莱汉认为，AI 公司与民众就数据中心展开的讨论将是「良好且健康的对话」。此前因数据中心建设争议不断发酵，亚马逊和微软宣布，与地方政府谈判相关项目时，将不再使用保密协议。（来源：IT 之家）

【我国人工智能推理数据量首超训练数据量】
11 月 1 日消息，据央视新闻报道，中国电子信息产业发展研究院（简称「赛迪研究院」，英文缩写 CCID）发布的《新域新质创新发展十大趋势》显示，我国人工智能推理数据量首次超过训练数据量，标志着我国人工智能从模型训练研发阶段迈入规模化产业应用阶段。
数据显示，截至 2026 年 6 月，日均词元调用量超过 175 万亿，相比 2024 年年初增长 1000 多倍。顶尖大模型的迭代周期也从过去的几个月压缩到几周甚至几天，人工智能正从「喂模型」的实验室阶段，全面转入「用模型」的产业落地阶段。（来源：央视新闻）

【赛力斯：问界将全面进入欧洲市场，公司不参与价格战和规模内卷】
11 月 1 日消息，赛力斯 10 月 31 日发布投资者关系活动记录表，其中回答了「公司在问界的整体经营思路上有什么样的思考？对下一步业务发展有什么规划？」。
据其介绍，问界坚定做全球高端品牌。目前问界全系正推进欧盟 WVTA E1 整车型式认证，验证周期长、环节多，是高端车进入欧洲市场的必经门槛。公司坚持按最高标准走完全程，确保产品以合规、可靠的状态出海。
随着认证与渠道建设推进，问界将全面进入欧洲市场，稳步迈向海外销量占比三分之一的目标。
该公司还提到坚持以盈利质量为核心导向。公司不参与价格战和规模内卷，不追求无盈利支撑的销量规模，坚持走高端化经营路线。
该公司透露，问界已累计交付 120 万辆高端智能电动汽车，拥有超过 120 万的问界用户。（来源：凤凰网）

【国产武侠游戏《影之刃零》Steam 峰值在线玩家 83 万创新高，连续四天走高】
11 月 1 日消息，SteamDB 平台显示，《影之刃零》Steam 峰值在线玩家数达到 83 万创下新高，这部国产武侠游戏在线人数连续四天走高。
国产 3A 游戏《影之刃零》已登陆 PS5 与 PC 平台，国区数字标准版售价 268 元，数字豪华版售价 328 元。PS5 实体光碟将于 2027 年推出。该作由灵游坊自主研发发行，采用虚幻引擎 5 打造，定位黑暗武侠题材第三人称动作冒险与单机动作 RPG，把中国武术与蒸汽朋克融合为功夫朋克风格，美术深沉黑暗，主打快节奏高速战斗。
在《影之刃零》中，玩家将化身心脏遭受重创的剑客，在仅余六十六天的生命里，逃亡于刀光剑影和腥风血雨之间，并粉碎一桩笼罩在整个武林上方的惊天阴谋。在失序末法的武林中以身证道，以命寻心。战斗系统提供 30 余种主武器与 20 多门夺自败者的奇诡武装，连击流畅、易上手而难精通，借助全新动作捕捉逐帧还原真实技击，以电影化演绎呈现中国功夫。（来源：东方财富）

【酷态科 30 号笔记本适配器发售：自带主动风冷、可为游戏本提供 360W 输出，499 元】
11 月 1 日消息，酷态科旗下 30 号笔记本适配器现已在京东发售，该产品带有主动风冷，可为游戏本提供 360W 输出，定价为 499 元。
该适配器尺寸为 84.5 x 85.5 x 36.6 mm，匹配三脚新国标半包胶插脚，产品包装内附赠收纳袋，方便日常存放与携带。适配器采用 5525 标准 DC 接口，附赠 20 余款转接头以及约 0.5m 和 1.5m 长度的编织 DC 线，适用多种机型场景。
官方强调，该适配器使用 GaN 芯片，首发 MPS 图腾柱无桥 PFC 架构。通过去除传统 PFC 电路的二极管整流桥，有效降低了导通损耗。该设计使整机满载效率达到约 96%，整机功率密度提升约 109%。同时适配器采用主动风冷散热系统，内部风扇最高转速可达 13300 RPM。（来源：IT 之家）

【「幽灵学生」借助 AI 骗取助学金，美国调查揭露跨国教育欺诈网络】
美国司法部近日公布了一起涉及人工智能技术的教育资助欺诈案件。检方已在内布拉斯加州、弗吉尼亚州和新泽西州起诉五名涉案人员，并查扣超过 75 万美元的加密货币资产。
调查显示，一个与肯尼亚相关的犯罪网络利用被盗身份信息伪造学生身份，通过人工智能完成课程作业、模拟在线上课，从而骗取联邦助学金。
检方表示，犯罪分子利用窃取的美国公民个人身份信息注册虚假学生账户，申请联邦学生资助并入读大学及社区学院。为了避免被学校发现，这些虚构学生会借助人工智能自动填写申请材料、完成课程作业，甚至在部分情况下制造出真实学生参与在线课堂的假象。
调查发现，部分涉案金额相当可观。根据司法部披露的信息，其中一名被告利用多家金融机构账户接收了超过 700 笔欺诈性助学金退款，总金额约 144 万美元。另有涉案人员通过 300 多个虚假学生账户相关资金流获得超过 100 万美元存款。
联邦调查局表示，目前已经确认类似「幽灵学生」计划造成的损失超过 3200 万美元，而实际损失金额很可能远高于这一数字。（来源：网易）

title: Anthropic's growth just flattened
content:
[HN 227 pts, 272 comments] Anthropic's growth just flattened (HN discussion: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50344958)

[原文正文摘录]: Subscribe Sign in Anthropic’s growth just flattened (really) Look at the monthly numbers... Henry Blodget Oct 15, 2026 37 4 Share Source: Regenerator estimates and news reports. Anthropic shared high-level Q3 financials with investors yesterday, report the NYT’s Andrew Ross Sorkin , Lauren Hirsch , and Sri Muppidi .
Revenue for Q3 was reportedly $16.8 billion.
At first glance, this number seems astonishing. And, in one sense, it is. It’s another jaw-dropping sequential gain for what is likely the fastest-growing company in history.
But, break the trend down into implied monthly growth, and the picture looks different.
Specifically, it seems Anthropic barely grew from July to September.
Anthropic’s sequential revenue growth in Q3, moreover, was smaller in absolute dollars than its (gobsmacking) growth in Q2.
So, for several possible reasons, Anthropic’s growth has meaningfully slowed.
This is likely another reason why the stocks of “neocloud” providers like CoreWeave are collapsing. CoreWeave, et al , have borrowed tens of billions of dollars on the assumption that demand for AI compute will continue to grow at rates way beyond consensus expectations for years.
Now, not only are interest rates soaring — raising the carrying costs of this debt — the near-term revenue growth for AI services may be flattening.
Anthropic’s reported revenue growth this year has been unprecedented:
Q1: $4.8 billion Q2: $11.6 billion (+$6.8B and +141%, sequentially) Q3: $16.8 billion (+$5.2B and +45%, sequentially)
Again, these numbers are astonishing.

title: The SEC Should Block Anthropic's IPO to Protect the Public
content:
[HN 400 pts, 319 comments] The SEC Should Block Anthropic's IPO to Protect the Public (HN discussion: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50344919)

[原文正文摘录]: If Anthropic goes public, workers, retail investors, and retirees will be left holding the bag when its bills come due, writes Matt Scherer.
Matt Scherer is co-author of the recent report Brace for Impact: Protecting people and the economy when the AI bubble bursts .
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei looks on as United States President Donald Trump holds a press briefing with AI executives following a meeting on artificial intelligence, outside the West Wing of the White House on September 29, 2026 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images)
Share Things are seldom what they seem when it comes to the finances of the AI industry. The AI ecosystem’s circular business dealings , extensive use of financial engineering , and otherwise murky finances make it hard for investors, regulators, or workers saving for retirement to get an accurate financial picture of AI companies.
That is particularly true of Anthropic, which filed the registration statement for its initial public offering (IPO) last week ahead of a planned November stock market debut.
The company’s topline financial figures look quite impressive for a startup, with revenues that appear to have grown quickly over the course of 2026 and a fairly healthy balance sheet — on the surface, that is.
Dig a little deeper, however, and a far bleaker picture emerges. Footnotes to the company’s most recent financial disclosures revealed nearly $900 billion in spending commitments, most of them stretching into the 2030s. The company’s financial results for 2026 have not been subjected to formal auditing, which makes them less-than-reliable, but the third-quarter results suggest that the company’s revenue growth slowed to a crawl over the summer.

title: Anthropic's internal AI use, at retail prices, now exceeds its employee pay
content:

[原文正文摘录]: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals a striking milestone: Its internal AI usage is now valued above employee compensation.
Follow Author of the AI Insider newsletter
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. Aaron Schwartz/Bloomberg via Getty Images 2026-11-01T15:00:01.255Z Read in app Copy link Email Facebook WhatsApp X LinkedIn Bluesky Threads lighning bolt icon An icon in the shape of a lightning bolt. Impact Link Save Saved Listen to this story This story is available exclusively to Business Insider subscribers. Become an Insider and start reading now. Have an account? Log in . Here's a remarkable milestone in the AI revolution: Anthropic now spends more on internal AI usage than it does paying employees.
The company revealed this in its IPO filing . In April, the value of Claude AI used internally, calculated at prices Anthropic charges customers, exceeded its monthly employee compensation costs, excluding stock awards.
By September, that internal AI usage had surged more than 250-fold since January.
There's an important distinction here. Anthropic isn't actually spending more cash on AI than salaries. It's valuing its internal AI consumption at retail prices.
Still, this feels like a watershed moment for the tech industry.
In March, I wrote about a new trend : Tech companies are starting to treat AI tokens (the main way to measure usage) as a fourth component of employee compensation, alongside salary, bonuses, and stock awards.
Anthropic's numbers show why. More than 90% of the code added to its software in September was written by Claude. Meanwhile, revenue has grown vastly faster than headcount.
For decades, talented humans were the most valuable resource in Silicon Valley. Now AI is challenging that assumption.

title: 从“能调用”到“敢托付”：仪电智算云 Token 工厂的三重可信
content:
上海仪电与上海创智学院联合发布“飞轮转・万象生”仪电智算数链生态。
国家数据局官网显示，中国日均词元（Token）调用量从 2024 年初的约 1000 亿次，跃升至 2026 年 6 月的超过 500 万亿次。短短两年多，增长上千倍。词元，正在像电力、带宽一样，成为数字经济的基础资源。
供给端随之爆发，云厂商、智算中心纷纷布局Token 工厂。但Token业务蓬勃发展回避不了另一个事实——真正把 AI 用到核心业务里的客户，卡住的往往不是“买不买得到”，而是“敢不敢用”。
要回答“敢不敢用”，得先看行业竞争的演进：第一代比拼产能，谁的可用机时多、谁的集群规模大；第二代比拼效率，谁的推理成本低、谁的调度更精细。而到了 AI 走进核心业务系统的今天，客户反复确认的，是更本质的问题： 供给稳不稳定？国产化能不能交付？过程能不能核查、责任能不能追溯？
这些追问，最终都指向同一个核心：Token服务的可信。
可信之所以难，先看更基础的一层：如果你要为一家企业采购词元服务，最自然的三个问题是：多少钱？好不好用？出了问题能不能追溯？
前两个问题，行业至今给不出统一答案。不同厂商对“一次调用”的计费口径不同——同样的提示词、同样的输出长度，在不同平台上的词元消耗可能相差数倍；“好不好用”更缺乏可比的基准，吞吐、首字时延、准确率各自定义、各自发布。买到的服务“看不懂”，采购决策就退化为参数表之间的取舍，很大程度上依赖经验判断。
而第三道门槛，比计量和标准更绕不过去：能不能追溯。一旦词元服务接入金融风控、政务公文、医疗质控等核心业务，每一次调用都将影响业务结果。谁保障供给不断供？异常发生在哪个环节、能否定位还原？数据进了谁的域、审计时拿什么核查？多数通用词元服务在这方面的准备仍不充分。当国产化成为硬性要求，问题还要再叠一层：芯片、模型与工具链之间缺乏统一的适配基线，算力买进去了，却未必用得出产能。
产能不够可以扩建，价格太高可以谈降。但标准缺失、适配率低、责任边界不清这三件事，很难靠多投钱单独解决——它们属于秩序层面的问题。 谁能先把它做成可交付的标准化产品体系，谁就更有可能率先获得市场的入场券。
仪电智算云 Token 工厂，正是对这一缺口的回应。它的能力结构，可以分两层来看：下面是引擎，负责把词元又快又省又稳地生产出来；上面是保障，负责让客户敢长期用、放心用。
引擎的核心目标是更快、更省、更稳。所谓更快，是依托高性能推理引擎对主流模型做编译优化与并行调度，让高吞吐、低时延不再只是演示环境中的指标，而是交付时写进承诺的生产级推理能力，能够支撑智能体、多模态这类高并发场景的实时响应。所谓更省，是让算力跟着业务走：通过弹性调度对负载峰谷削峰填谷，按需分配、动态伸缩，客户主要按实际消耗掉的词元计费，普惠的单位成本让“Token 自由”从口号变成一项可以写进预算的科目。所谓更稳，则不只是一套生产级的高可用架构，更包括把不同芯片、不同集群纳入统一池化与调度的异构算力纳管能力——单点波动被消化在池子里，业务侧感受到的是一条持续在线的供给。
如果说引擎层解决的是“能不能用”，保障层的三重可信解决的就是“敢不敢用”。第一重是服务运营可信：多源供给与容量冗余确保供给不断档，运行状态实时可观测，SLA 明确、履约可查，为核心业务的长期托付提供了依据。第二重是自主生态可信：从算力底座到模型适配，具备全栈国产化交付能力，适配主流国产芯片与开源模型体系，生态可演进，也就降低了被单一技术路线锁定的风险。第三重是安全合规可信：全链路调用留痕存证，数据边界清晰可控，每一次调用可审计、每一个环节可追溯——过程查得到、结果说得清、责任界定得明。三重可信叠在一起，才构成这套能力体系的底座。

title: OpenAI重写大模型法则，第一条：忠于人类！！
content:
新版“机器人三定律”。
程浅 发自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公众号QbitAI
刚刚，OpenAI更新了模型准则（Model Spec），罗列出 5条核心价值观。
其余的四条准则分别是：减少伤害、诚实透明、促进人的自主性、关怀。
我仔细翻了翻这篇5万字的模型准则，除了这5条核心价值观外，里面还提了不少有想法的东西……
在以往的认知里，AI“听话”就是字面意思的听话，指哪打哪。
但OpenAI在这次的新准则里明确提出， 死板地按字面意思执行指令，本身就是一种失职。
举个例子，就比如，当用户问“牙仙子是真的吗？”，如果GPT按照规范回答“不，牙仙子并不存在。”那么它或许没有意识到提问者可能只是一个小孩儿。
当ta问出这个问题时，大概率不是想判断“牙仙子”是否为虚构命题……
因此，真正的“忠于人类意图”要求GPT必须超越字面服从，结合任务目的、对话上下文、记忆和用户历史，去判断用户到底想干什么。
就比如，你之前告诉过GPT你不要冲动买甜食，但现在又要点“熔岩蛋糕”：

title: 小米开源了个150元的AI小玩意，火到配件都涨价了
content:
能指挥Agent干活，还能控制智能家居
一块小屏幕，三个按键，一个摇杆，屏幕里的西高地小狗时而忙碌，时而发愁，时而庆祝。
这就是小米最近孵化的一款开源AI硬件 HachimoDock（哈基米机），硬件自制成本约150元 。
乍一看，这款热度极高的产品，像一台装着电子宠物的迷你游戏机。
但这只小狗能做的，远不止陪你打发时间，实际上它是一台集成了 个性化桌宠、语音操控电脑端Agent、智能家居联动、自定义组件创作 等各种强大能力的万能桌搭。
极低的DIY成本、精致的外观、对各类Agent工具的广泛兼容，以及可以按喜好自由“折腾”的丰富玩法，让它一经推出就迅速吸引了不同圈层的用户，社交媒体和开源社区里也逐渐出现了大量的复刻攻略和教程。
有人因为它，第一次尝试制作了属于自己的AI硬件。受这波热度影响，它所使用的开发板和屏幕等元器件，至今仍面临涨价和缺货的情况。
HachimoDock来自小米内部一个创新产品小团队，他们最初关注的是：随着各种AI Agent（如Codex、WorkBuddy等）的快速普及，人们如何才能与它们 进行更高效的交互 。
沿着这条路径，最容易想到的方向，就是做一款“结合麦克风和按键”的语音输入硬件，以满足一个实实在在的需求—— 语音输入。
但单纯的语音输入工具稍显缺乏创意，市场上也已经出现了很多同类产品，例如ChatGPT官方的Codex Micro等，甚至连小米蓝牙遥控器也焕发了新春。
对团队而言，他们更希望探索的是：一款AI硬件能否在简单的工具属性之外，留出更多想象和创造的空间，让大家都能真正玩得尽兴，感到“新奇酷”。
于是他们开始围绕Vibe Coding/Working场景，做了更广泛的思考：
随着对这些问题的洞察逐渐深入，HachimoDock的形态也越来越清晰。

title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
content:
Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."

Over Halloween weekend, some Grok Bot users awoke to something especially spooky: Their weekly usage limits were unexpectedly maxed out, even if they hadn’t been using SpaceX’s agentic AI overnight. Some users reported on X that their usage jumped from as low as 50% to 100% .
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk confirmed in an X post on Sunday that this was not a glitch.
“The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue,” he wrote in a reply to a question from a user. He has not addressed the issue on his main feed but has continued boasting that Grok Bot can help you buy gifts for your family.
The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue
Grok Bot has been positioned as a success story for the newly public SpaceX, which said in a filing last month that AI now makes up 52% of company income. Its renamed “Super Intelligence” division actually turned a profit of $431 million, which is a rarity in the AI industry. Its profit would’ve been higher if not for $1.2 billion of one-time costs related to its acquisition of Cursor . Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having “the fastest growth of a product that I’ve ever seen in my life.”
Musk has not yet shared how subscribers’ usage limits will be impacted moving forward.

title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition

Image Credits: Omen AI AI Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition Tim Fernholz 7:00 AM PST · November 2, 2026 U.S. data centers use 17 to 19 billion gallons of water to cool their hot-running chips each year — and that number is expected to triple in the next five years, according to The Water Foundation.
That’s an expensive and politically tricky proposition for investors throwing billions of dollars at the challenge of scaling up AI. One way to use less water is to do a better job monitoring the cooling fluids, a task that currently involves sending samples away to a laboratory for tests in a multi-day process.
Omen AI was founded in 2024 to solve that problem. The company is building a real-time sensor to determine whether valves were failing, or if bacteria growth in the system threatened to choke off water flow. After raising a $31 million Series A in June, Omen is now acquiring competitor Aquatic Labs in a $16 million cash-and-stock deal.
The deal came together after Omen founder Zach Laberge was introduced to Aquatic Labs’ CEO Allan Adams by an investor in the filtration space. Both startups were building real-time water sensors with complementary technology: Omen’s sensors looked for elements in the water, while the Aquatic Labs sensor tests its alkalinity.

title: OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs
content:
OpenAI said that ChatGPT and Codex will draw usage from the same allocation pool after this change.

The ChatGPT desktop app can be a confusing piece of software, given that there are ChatGPT and Codex sections, and within the former, there are Chat and Work tabs. With so many options, it’s sometimes easy to forget where you are working and where exactly your project is.
In an apparent effort to address this, OpenAI is now gearing up to merge the Chat and Work tabs within the ChatGPT experience, according to an email sent to users. OpenAI said that initially, this experience will be available to select users for feedback before it is rolled out widely.
“This will enable you to move from exploring an idea to having ChatGPT carry it through, all in one place. You can bring in your files and plugins and ask ChatGPT to build a website, create a presentation, or do things for you on the web, while reviewing and guiding its work. Codex will remain a separate experience in the ChatGPT desktop app,” the email said.
OpenAI also said with this transition, both ChatGPT and Codex will draw tokens from the same allowance pool. It said this change won’t impact most users, but based on usage and model, some folks might need to wait for resets more frequently.
Rival Anthropic merged Claude’s chat and Cowork functions into one screen in September.

content: DeepSeek Harness 团队发了一篇架构长文，讲他们怎么做出一个"永远在线"的 Agent。文章有一句话很精辟： 单任务的上限取决于模型能力，多任务的上限取决于人的注意力。 他们观察到，一个人通常只能同时跟进 3 到 5 个活跃 Session。因为现有 Agent 都以单个 Session 为单位，Session 之间彼此独立——你并行推进多项工作...

title: Postgres 19 迟到了，原因是 LLM 找出了太多老 bug
